build_VitNormalHead: build a VitNormalHead decode head with configurable deconv and conv layers for ViT segmentation
create_make_conv_layers: create convolutional layers with InstanceNorm2d and SiLU activation using _make_conv_layers method
create_make_deconv_layers: create deconvolutional upsample layers with InstanceNorm2d and SiLU using _make_deconv_layers method
run_forward_pass: run the forward pass through deconv and conv layers to produce segmentation logits
compute_loss_by_feat: compute segmentation loss by resizing logits and comparing against ground truth depth maps
